name: ColdEmailKit

sources.title: Submit your Cold Email Tool — open form (name, email, tool name, website URL, 'suggest an alternative'); review criteria listed
Homepage — directory of 50+ cold email tools with reviews, trust scores, alternatives and compare pages; has Advertise link

requirements: Product must be a cold email tool — narrowly scoped directory (inbox rotation, deliverability, sequencing, lead data for outreach)
Should position as an 'alternative to' an existing tool — the form includes a 'Suggest an alternative' field
'Submission alone does not guarantee a feature' — editorial review applies
Form fields: your name, your email, tool name, website URL, alternative suggestion, newsletter opt-in checkbox
preparation: The incumbent tool(s) yours is an alternative to (Apollo, Instantly, Lemlist, etc.)
A short positioning line — listings show 'Free Alternative to: X' cards with starting price
workflow: Fill the five fields (no account required for the form itself — 'Sign In' exists but submit form is open)
Submit and wait for editorial review
If listed, the tool gets a profile card with trust score, reviews, pricing, and 'alternative to' mapping
watchFor: Very niche — only cold-email/outreach tools qualify; a general SaaS will be rejected
Listings carry editorial content ('we review warm-up, A/B testing...') — they write reviews, your listing copy isn't fully yours
Trust Score metric displayed prominently; a brand-new tool starts near 0%
Paid 'Advertise' placements exist alongside organic listings
countsAsLive: The tool appears as a card/profile on coldemailkit.com (e.g. under /alternatives or category pages) with its own detail page
unknowns: Whether the listing link is dofollow
Whether signing in unlocks additional submission fields
